title: Writer Workflow Validation
objective: Memvalidasi drafting, lore links, voice, POV, pacing, snapshot, boards, quest, dan contradiction flow.

workflow_results.description: Setiap komponen workflow menghasilkan output yang valid dan dapat dikonsumsi oleh langkah berikutnya.
components: end_to_end_writer_workflow (planning → draft → link → validate → revise → snapshot → export)

errors.description: Error handling terdokumentasi: input kosong, aturan tidak valid, snapshot overflow, contradiction ambigu.
scenarios: empty_plan → workflow adds 'plan is empty' issue
empty_draft → workflow proceeds with empty link targets

recovery.description: Recovery paths: draft snapshot restore, contradiction dismissal persistence, plot board reorder rollback.
paths: draft_snapshot: restoreTo creates backup before restore, original recoverable
contradiction_inbox: dismiss writes to dismissal store, restore clears
contradiction_inbox: resolve records in history without touching dismissal
plot_board: story_sync returns cards grouped by chapter with orphaned cards

usability_feedback.description: Komponen menyediakan feedback yang dapat dimengerti manusia untuk membantu penulis.
feedback_types: voice_consistency: explain_warning returns rule + term + suggestion
pacing_heatmap: HintKind.longPlateau for flat tension sequences
contradiction_analysis: finding carries source_citations with locations
plot_board: story_sync groups cards by chapter, orphaned cards listed separately

limits: Native GUI, hosted CI, signing, hardware, public release DEFERRED. Validation bersifat domain-only: exercised components are in-memory pure Dart, not wired to live database or UI.
